notes: Transmitter optical output power and BER footnote: BER = 10^-10 @ 125 Mbps, PRBS 2^7-1, NRZ, IEEE-802.3z and ANSI X3.297 / FC-PH-2. Receiver optical sensitivity footnote: BER = 10^-10 @ 1.25 Gbps, PRBS 2^7-1, NRZ, same standards. Rx data squelched (JAM) when LOS asserted. Features list duplex LC receptacle wording; product description is singlemode with duplex LC. Ordering code FNK-LT12: F=Front Load Low Rider, LT12=SM 1310 nm; optional conformal coat (M), no GND tabs (N), Fast Ethernet variant (K). Supply currents stated (Tx ICC 120–160 mA, Rx ICC 70–120 mA at 3.3 V) but power in watts not given. DDMI alarm thresholds duplicate some TX/RX power limits (e.g. TX low alarm -9.5 dBm, RX low alarm -21 dBm).
